Title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now in preview

Body.Content:
Flexible Server is a new deployment option for Azure Database for PostgreSQL that gives you the control you need with multiple configuration parameters for fine-grained database tuning along with a simpler developer experience to accelerate end-to-end deployment. With Flexible Server, you will also have a new way to optimize cost with stop/start capabilities that enable you to only pay for compute when the server is in use.  Flexible Server is also fully compatible with community PostgreSQL, is available with PostgreSQL 11 and 12 support, and can be used for a variety of workloads.

Learn more about Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
